Marvel's Spider-Man 2 — PS5 Buying Guide

PlayStation 5 · Updated 2026-08-05

Marvel's Spider-Man 2 is the PS5 exclusive that puts you in control of both Peter Parker and Miles Morales, swinging through a bigger, faster New York with the new Web Wings glide.

What's new

  • Two playable Spider-Men with distinct power sets
  • The Symbiote suit story arc and a larger open world
  • Dual protagonists and faster traversal (Web Wings)

Standard vs Digital Deluxe

  • Standard — the full game
  • Digital Deluxe — early unlock of 10 suits + a few points; cosmetic only

Unless you want those suits on day one, Standard is the better value.

Where to buy cheapest (PS5)

As a PlayStation console exclusive, your options are the PlayStation Store and key resellers. A GMG PSN wallet-code or key can sometimes beat direct Store pricing, especially during site sales. Always compare the total against PlayStation Store wallet-credit promos before buying.

Where to buy

  • Check Green Man Gaming
  • Check on Amazon
